verdict.rationale: Browser Use is API-first. A published OpenAPI v4 spec, SDK calls for runs, sessions, cloud browsers, profiles and event polling, and the live_view_url returned via API events together cover the main workflows programmatically. However, no documentation claims or demonstrates parity with a dashboard UI, and profile creation and account/billing operations are not shown as API-accessible. missing for 10: explicit API–UI parity statement, evidence that account/billing/profile management and dashboard features are API-accessible, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
